excluded_orphaned_run.reason: Orphaned by an infrastructure interruption mid-run; reconciled to status=failed/SERVER_RESTARTED. Not used anywhere in this revalidation.

1_ticker_consistency.method: Recomputed from current persisted artifacts: metadata.json (requested), run_audit.json (persisted), v0_1_3_final_fresh_six_ticker_ledger.json (selected_run_id + ticker), alpha_matches.json and structure_graph.json (run artifact), regression_report_v3.json (regression ledger).

2_artifact_completeness.method: Read outputs/runs/<run_id>/artifact_manifest.json directly for each of the six final selected runs only (no orphaned/superseded/intermediate run counted).

3_graph_edge_count.method: Read run_audit.json graph_edge_count directly for each final selected run -- not recomputed.

gold_evaluability_check.result: Zero of the alpha expectations across all six tickers carry APPROVED_GOLD / acceptance-eligible authority.

4_expected_alpha_hit_rate.reason: No approved frozen Gold benchmark exists for the six FINAL_FRESH_SELECTED runs.

diagnostic_only_not_an_acceptance_gate.label: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY / NOT_AN_ACCEPTANCE_GATE -- never compared against the >=75% acceptance target.

gold_evaluability_check.method: comqutor_alpha.regression.authority_contract.main_conflict_expectations_for_ticker() against the same authority audit for all six tickers.
gold_evaluability_check.result: Zero of the main-conflict expectations across all six tickers carry acceptance-eligible (APPROVED_GOLD) authority. MSFT's only recorded expectation (A102__A304) is explicitly REJECTED_OR_SUPERSEDED and was NOT used. All others are DOCUMENTED_EXPECTATION or PROVISIONAL_AI_PREDICTED, neither of which is Gold.

5_main_conflict_match.reason: No approved frozen Gold main-conflict benchmark exists for the six FINAL_FRESH_SELECTED runs. Not forced to 4/6; no superseded expectation used; current outputs not used as their own Gold.

6_frozen_evidence_review_authority.note: The human-reviewed labels (item2_blind_holdout5_review_frozen.csv) are FROZEN and were not touched by this revalidation -- only read.

7_alpha_match_accuracy.method: Recomputed directly from docs/audit_artifacts/item2_blind_holdout5_comparison.csv's alpha_correct column across all 200 rows -- NOT assumed from a prior report.

8_polarity_accuracy.method: Recomputed directly from item2_blind_holdout5_comparison.csv, restricted to review_material_alpha_fit==True rows (62), excluding holdout5-005 (formally adjudicated BOTH_REASONABLE_AMBIGUOUS -> AMBIGUOUS_DIRECTION, ineligible under the existing, unmodified eligibility contract). Eligibility rule itself was not changed.

9_critical_support_opposition_reversal.method: Recomputed directly from the same 61 eligible rows: a reversal is {review_polarity, system_polarity} == {supports_alpha, opposes_alpha}.
9_critical_support_opposition_reversal.raw_pool_note: One raw reversal exists in the pre-eligibility 62-row pool (holdout5-005) but is excluded from this count by the general eligibility rule, not omitted or hidden -- see Section 8.

10_consistency_with_current_final_runs.finding: The Blind Holdout #5 evidence review set is an INTENTIONALLY FROZEN benchmark drawn from 17 historical run_ids across 8 tickers (including GOOGL and MU, outside the current six-ticker scope), frozen and reviewed BEFORE this session's fresh six-ticker production run set ever existed. It is explicitly independent of the six FINAL_FRESH_SELECTED run IDs and was NOT rewritten to force fresh-run linkage -- doing so would itself violate the review's own frozen-benchmark integrity guarantees (see item2_blind_holdout5_internal_report.md Section 12, production_semantic_drift=0).

overall_verdict: REVALIDATION_CONFIRMS_PRIOR_RESULTS -- all eight recomputed metrics are identical to previously reported values; no discrepancy found. Ticker consistency 6/6, artifact completeness 6/6, graph edges 6/6, Alpha Match 83.0% PASS, Polarity 85.25% PASS, Critical Reversal 0 PASS. Expected Alpha Hit Rate and Main Conflict Match both correctly remain NOT_GOLD_EVALUABLE -- not manufactured as PASS.
